title: Can I reactivate a number that was deactivated for non-payment?
content:
Question: Can I reactivate a number that was deactivated for non-payment?

Answer: Reactivation is possible within the operator's retention window (commonly up to 90 days) by clearing dues and completing any required re-verification. Beyond this window the number may be permanently released and cannot be recovered.

Topic: Termination & Deactivation
